note: Gate D W1 — D01 (Player Detail Overview, position evidence), D02 (Player Detail Evidence, position-dot consolidation), D04 (Player Detail Matches, minute coverage), D07 (attribute evolution review, directional), D08 (primary position proposal, directional), D09 (evidence lineage). D03/D06 (Assistant Coach cross-source hypothesis) deferred to Wave 2. UPDATE 2026-11-23: the product owner resolved the two authority conflicts that originally blocked D07/D08 (ADR-0139 vs. mandatory coach approval; ADR-0154 vs. the 14-role profile vocabulary) via ADR-0160 (docs/adr/0160-coach-approved-position-and-attribute-mutation-policy.md), which partially supersedes ADR-0139/ADR-0092 and additively extends ADR-0154. This resolves the conflicts as DECISIONS, not as production implementation — no schema, service, or write-path change was made anywhere in this wave. D07/D08's candidates are therefore directional design candidates for a decided-but-unimplemented policy (not production-component mounts for the review/approval interaction itself, since no such interaction exists in production yet), explicitly labeled as such, following the same precedent Gate A already set with its own a06/a12 directional studies. D09 was found, on re-audit, to be independent of the D07/D08 conflict entirely — real supersession machinery already ships in qualitative-evidence-service.ts; D09 exposes that existing lineage through new presentation. No production code was changed anywhere in this wave. scripts/ui-lab-visual-review.mjs registers all eleven routes for CI capture (consistent with every prior gate's wave). capture-attestation.json is not yet included; it requires a real CI capture run. All candidates are CANDIDATE, pending owner review — none approved, none merged, none self-approved.
